issue_description: pw_stream uses static_cast() to cast types up to a generic Stream and then down to a smaller API subset (such as stream::Writer) using static_cast. This downcast can sometimes be to a completely different type, which technically relies on undefined behavior. This undefined behavior is detectable during fuzz testing and can cause issues such as UBSAN errors. The vulnerability lies in pw::stream::Stream relying on undefined behavior when casting between unrelated types using static_cast in stream adapters.
